verdict.rationale: NVIDIA provides official developer SDKs for RTX GPUs including the CUDA Toolkit, cuTile Python/C++ tile programming APIs, and Nsight profiling tools, plus curated GPU-optimized SDKs spanning Windows ML, Ollama, and PyTorch backends — a clear AI-native build surface. Missing for 10: independent developer corroboration of SDK usability, working docs-as-markdown/OpenAPI endpoints (probes returned 404s), and concrete quickstart/tutorial evidence.
